subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: - Departure: June 15th, 2023 at 10:00 AM - Arrival: June 16th, 2023 at 2:00 PM - Flight number: AB123 Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Warm regards, The Travel Agency
